outcome: Spontaneous preterm delivery (SPTD) ≤14 days of sampling
Microbial invasion of the amniotic cavity (MIAC)
cohort: The study included 76 singleton pregnant women with early preterm premature rupture of membranes (PPROM) at 23-30 weeks gestation.
finding: High plasma S100A8/A9 levels were associated with SPTD, elevated plasma MMP-9, S100A9, and S100A8/A9 levels were associated with MIAC/IAI, and decreased plasma endoglin levels were associated with an increased CNMM risk.
